questions.question: Imagine a funding agreement restricts a cost category, but an expense is coded there and has already appeared in a draft report. How would you validate the restriction, correct the accounting, and explain the resolution to the program owner?
What do you understand by funding source regulations and requirements, and what approach would you take in your first 90 days to learn the specific restrictions that govern assigned programs?

Suppose actual spending is trending above budget halfway through the year. How would you develop a revised projection, identify the drivers of the variance, and communicate the outlook to program leadership?

Walk me through how you would turn a completed period close package into a set of financial statements. Which reconciliations, review steps, and supporting schedules would you complete before issuing the statements?

Describe a journal entry you have calculated, documented, reviewed, and posted or otherwise prepared for posting. What was the business purpose, what support did you retain, and how did you validate the debit-credit logic?
A program manager asks you to book an expense immediately but cannot provide sufficient support or a clear funding source. How would you respond, what would you document, and when would you escalate?

You discover after a close deadline that a material expense was charged to the wrong program. How would you determine the correcting entry, obtain appropriate approval, post it, and assess the effect on the financial statements?

In this role, program transactions must follow established accounting procedures and possibly funding restrictions. How would you design your review process to catch coding, allowability, or documentation problems before month-end close?

How would you reconcile a program-level expense report to the general ledger and then to the financial-statement line item? Please describe the sequence of checks and the types of differences you would expect.

What experience do you have building an annual budget from operational assumptions? Please explain the inputs you used, how you structured the budget, and how you reconciled it to underlying financial data.
